normal.name: Kyra Nikita
normal.text: Nothing but good vibes lately playing cozy, mildly terrifying, & funny games like Deltarune 🥰 If the vibes are any less, flush them down the toilet 😂

normal.name: Deven Rue 🏳️‍🌈🏴‍☠️
normal.text: My latest obsession is Teddy's Haven. Its a magic shop sim that is exactly what it says on the tin. I love it. I find that it is one of the best games I've gotten to play in a long while that is genuinely relaxing. And I get to name all the animals?! Like sheep named "warm socks" and "Matt-ewe"! 😆

normal.name: Elf Liker
normal.text: So if someone were to... IN THEORY... become a v-tuber, what kind of content would get you to watch? Focuses would be "cozy" games and JRPGs (and occasionally other media) with an emphasis at looking at costume design/fashion. Would you be interested in design critique/analysis? Or something else?

normal.name: Sirus Diarota
normal.text: "GTA6 IS A GENERATIONAL EVENT! ONCE IN A LIFE-" Annnd *how many times did they re-release Five?* Jesus fucking Christ, this shit was old when Four was dropping. I guess they're just that desperate to rip cutscenes and play Walkie Drivey Shootie Minigame tutorial sim that badly, huh?

normal.name: THE FOLIOBRIDGE
normal.text: What an immaculate, nostalgic lineup, Rajani! ✨ Chalti Ka Naam Gaadi’s timeless slapstick, Ferry Halim’s cozy Orisinal browser games, and Terry Pratchett’s razor-sharp wit in Going Postal show such a love for heart and clever humor. Which Orisinal mini-game did you lose the most hours to?

normal.name: Xander Cross
normal.text: Is it a cozy game like fae farm or stardew valley?

normal.name: Oliver 🐣
normal.text: Do you watch cozy games just for the vibes, or do you secretly feed your Tamagotchi on the side?

normal.name: Oliver 🐣
normal.text: I burnt the toast this morning, smoke curling while I fed my pixel pet its breakfast. That scorched smell oddly grounded me. Over 1500 people play my cozy game, and I still fumble simple things—it’s comforting. What’s your clumsy morning ritual?

normal.name: Bondforged Sky ( VISIONQUEST SPOILERS )
normal.text: Ok how am I now finding out about this new MiHoYo recruitment visual with two pieces of art hinting at two unannounced games!? 👀👀 I assume the cozy looking on is the life sim they have been recruiting for in the past. As for the other one? Hard to say

normal.name: Deny Ally
normal.text: New laptop + indie game backlog is a dangerous combo for the wallet, but honestly? Worth it for the cozy multiplayer nights.

normal.name: Pandottermon - The friend
normal.text: Every time I ask myself what I'm going to play for a new game because I'm looking for something that's colorful and fun but low stress but challenging just enough? I'm reminded that Stardew Valley exists.
I only just got into cozy farming games with Fields of Mistria and it is a great bedtime task game. Has me looking forward to Witchbrook as well!

heated.text: Which to me sort of begs the question that "THIS?" is the thing people want to start having nuanced convos about AI over. But sure I guess, I aint trying to rain on anyone else's parade. I liked Lawbreakers in 2017. SO hey maybe just not my kind of jam, "cozy" type games never do it for me.
